cases.title: A task escalates and only its branch pauses
steps: Build and use the fake provider in a temp repo as TESTING.md "How to see the app" describes, with the diamond fixture

Write the fake script {"task:2":{"attempts":[{"escalate":{"reason":"Task 2 contradicts the spec","evidence":"src/x.ts:1","questions":[{"id":"q1","question":"A or B?","suggestedOptions":["A","B"]}]}}]}} and start the run with --web
Poll GET state and read .graph-execution/<run-id>/state.json
cases.expected: Tasks 1 and 3 merge, task 2 shows needs decision (escalated), task 4 stays pending, state.json has escalations [{id: E1, node: 2, status: open}] and escalations/E1.json exists

cases.title: Continue reruns only the escalated task
steps: Start the P1 run
POST escalations/resolve with {"escalationIds":["E1"],"action":"continue","guidance":"use B"}
Use GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_PROMPTS to read the last prompt of task 2
cases.expected: Response 200; the prompt of task 2 contains ## Decision and use B; tasks 1 and 3 ran once; the run ends with exit 0

cases.title: Change edits, adds and reopens tasks
steps: Start the P1 run
Resolve with action change: edit the content of task 4, add task 5 depending on 4, reopen task 1
cases.expected: Task 1 runs again with 'already merged into this checkout' in its prompt, task 5 runs, <runDir>/tasks/ holds 5 tasks, the fixture task folder is unchanged, the run is applied

cases.title: Ctrl+C while waiting, then --resume
steps: Start the P1 run in a terminal without --web
When task 2 is escalated press Ctrl+C
Run graph-execution --resume
Resolve E1 with continue
cases.expected: Ctrl+C exits 2; --resume returns to the wait with E1 open; after the resolution the run finishes

cases.title: Escalation screen and advisor terminal
steps: Start the P1 run with --web and a fake script that also has {"advisor:E1":{"attempts":[],"draft":{"escalationIds":["E1"],"action":"continue","guidance":"B"}}}
Open the page with agent-browser, open the Decision tab, click Talk to an agent
Type draft then Enter in the terminal, then click Apply resolution
cases.expected: The tab shows the reason, evidence and questions; the terminal prints advisor ready (E1); the draft summary appears; Apply resumes the run and the tab closes

cases.title: Two escalations at different times and a stale resolution
steps: Script tasks 2 and 3 to escalate
Resolve E1 alone, then try to resolve E1 again
Resolve E2
cases.expected: Task 4 waits until both are resolved; resolving E1 twice gives 409 with code not_open; a joint resolution with both ids also works

cases.title: graph-execution resolve on a live and a stopped run
steps: Live: start the P1 run with --web and run graph-execution resolve --file r.json
Stopped: start the P1 run, SIGINT it, run graph-execution resolve --file r.json, then --resume
cases.expected: Live: exit 0 and the run continues; stopped: exit 0 with the --resume hint and --resume finishes; a refused resolution exits 1 with refused (<code>)

cases.title: Fixer escalation
steps: Script a reviewer blocker in round 0 and the fixer fix-r1 to escalate
Resolve with continue; in a second run resolve with change reopening task 1
cases.expected: The review pauses at fix with an escalation on node fixer; continue reruns the fixer with the decision; change reruns task 1 and the review restarts at a new round with a fresh fix budget

cases.title: --no-escalation keeps today's behaviour
steps: Run with --no-escalation and the P1 script
Run with a task whose validation always fails
cases.expected: No escalation text in task prompts; the escalation file is ignored; exhausted validation aborts with validation failed after 3 rounds

cases.title: graph-manager terminals and proxy
steps: Run npm test -w graph-manager
Check git diff on the apps/graph-manager test files
If graph-manager can be started (apps/graph-manager README), open a run page with an escalation through it and start the advisor
cases.expected: All graph-manager tests pass with no test file changed; the advisor terminal connects through the run proxy of graph-manager
